claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Zamifenacin is a potent, selective M3 muscarinic antagonist with no reported cytotoxic or antiproliferative activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines, with any killing attributable to nonspecific physicochemical effects rather than a defined cytotoxic mechanism.
